component.name: podcast-sanity
component.summary: Record and master a podcast locally, offline

description.p: podcast-sanity records audio and masters it on the machine, with no upload and no cloud service. It applies the same chain a broadcast engineer would: click and DC repair, adaptive mains hum notch, content aware high pass, acoustic Filler Killer (hesitations and empty pauses, no transcription), spectral denoise, de-reverb, de-esser, an adaptive leveler, a compressor and loudness plus true peak normalisation to the delivery standard.

Loudness is measured with an implementation of ITU-R BS.1770-4 and true peak with 4x oversampling. The defaults follow the Apple Podcasts authoring practices (-19 LUFS mono, -16 LUFS stereo, true peak no higher than -1 dBTP). Every run produces a JSON quality report with per stage timings, real time factor, parameters hash and conformance flags.
First release: recording, the full mastering chain, loudness and true peak conformance, the Filler Killer, the session library and the export to MP3, WAV and FLAC.
